target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.publisher: Komite Nasional Keselamatan Transportasi (KNKT), Republic of Indonesia
evidence.observation: KNKT identifies Sriwijaya Air flight SJY182 as Boeing 737-500 PK-CLC on a scheduled passenger flight; the accident was fatal.

evidence.scope: global commercial aviation under IATA methodology
evidence.observation: IATA reports seven fatal accidents in 2021: one involved jet aircraft and six involved turboprops. The jet fatal accident is Sriwijaya Air B737-500 with 62 onboard fatalities.
evidence.use: annual fatal-jet universe and membership reconciliation

evidence.source_title: 2021 Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents
evidence.scope: worldwide commercial jet fleet under Boeing definitions
evidence.observation: The 2021 airplane-accident table records Sriwijaya B737-500 with 62 onboard fatalities and zero external fatalities. Other listed 2021 commercial-jet accidents are nonfatal, so no additional Boeing external-fatality-only target case is hidden outside IATA's fatal-jet count.

completeness_assessment.reason: IATA establishes that 2021 had a single fatal jet accident, KNKT establishes that event as Sriwijaya Boeing 737-500, and Boeing independently reports 62 onboard and zero external fatalities with no additional fatal commercial-jet event in its annual table.

gate_effect: 2021 annual cell PASS; overall G1 remains BLOCKED until every required annual cell passes
